top_signals.title: China’s Zijin Gold and Allied Gold Scrap $3.9 Billion Merger
top_signals.summary: Zijin Gold International Co.’s C$5.5 billion ($3.9 billion) takeover of Canada’s Allied Gold Corp. was scrapped after the mining deal failed to get Chinese regulatory approvals ahead of a contractual deadline. Shares of the Toronto-based metals producer plunged.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Consumers Continue to Grow More Cautious
top_signals.summary:
US consumer confidence fell in July as Americans’ views about current business conditions and the labor market deteriorated. 
Elevated gasoline and food prices likely weighed on US households, underscoring broader concerns about persistent inflation and the rising cost of living.
Julia Wilson, Principal: Consumer & Retail Strategy at KPMG, talks about the squeezed consumer and the back-to-school ramp-up affecting economic data. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Commission opens in-depth investigation into arbitration award ordering Romania to pay compensation to ten energy investors
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 Jul 2026 The European Commission has opened an in-depth investigation to assess whether an arbitration award ordering Romania to pay compensation to ten investors for changes to a renewable electricity support measure is in line with EU State aid rules.

top_signals.summary:
The CEO of BNSF says Union Pacific’s latest regulatory filing does nothing to change the anti-competitive aspects of the $85 billion rail merger.

top_signals.title: Commission endorses Malta's €60 million Social Climate Plan to support vulnerable households and small companies in the clean transition
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 Jul 2026 The European Commission has today endorsed Malta's Social Climate Plan – the fourth national plan adopted under the Social Climate Fund using revenues from carbon pricing to ensure a fair and inclusive clean transition. Malta's plan will mobilise €60.6 million until 2032, including €45.4 million from the European Union.
